1 : 0);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(off);\n        off += c;\n    }\n}\n\n// Generates exactly the same sequence as the original implementation: every\n// rank replays the generator, but only stores the data it needs (full positions,\n// local velocities).\nvoid randomizeBodies(Bodies& b, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    const size_t end = b.begin + b.count;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < b.n; ++i) {\n        const double x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const double y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const double z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const double vx = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const double vy = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const double vz = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        b.px[i] = x;\n        b.py[i] = y;\n        b.pz[i] = z;\n        if (i >= b.begin && i < end) {\n            b.vx[i - b.begin] = vx;\n            b.vy[i - b.begin] = vy;\n            b.vz[i - b.begin] = vz;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes the force on every locally owned body from all n bodies and updates\n// the local velocities. The inner loop runs over j in the original order so the\n// floating-point accumulation order (and thus the result) is unchanged.\nvoid computeForces(Bodies& b) {\n    const size_t n = b.n;\n    const double* __restrict px = b.px.data();\n    const double* __restrict py = b.py.data();\n    const double* __restrict pz = b.pz.data();\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < b.count; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = b.begin + li;\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n\n        b.vx[li] += DT * Fx;\n        b.vy[li] += DT * Fy;\n        b.vz[li] += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Integrates the locally owned positions in place (inside the global arrays).\nvoid integrateBodies(Bodies& b) {\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < b.count; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = b.begin + li;\n        b.px[i] += b.vx[li] * DT;\n        b.py[i] += b.vy[li] * DT;\n        b.pz[i] += b.vz[li] * DT;\n    }\n}\n\n// Exchanges the updated positions so every rank holds the full set again.\nvoid exchangePositions(Bodies& b, const std::vector<int>& counts, const std::vector<int>& displs) {\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, b.px.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, b.py.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, b.pz.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// Total energy (unit masses). Kinetic part from local velocities, potential part\n// over pairs i<j with the i rows distributed cyclically for load balance; the\n// partial sums are reduced onto rank 0 (only rank 0's return value = 0; li < b.count; ++li) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (b.vx[li] * b.vx[li] +\n                         b.vy[li] * b.vy[li] +\n                         b.vz[li] * b.vz[li]);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(rank); i < n; i += static_cast<size_t>(size)) {\n        const double xi = b.px[i], yi = b.py[i], zi = b.pz[i];\n double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    double total = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&energy, &total, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, validateSimulation(const Bodies& b) {\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < b.count; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = b.begin + li;\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(b.px[i]) > maxPos || std::abs(b.py[i]) > maxPos || std::abs(b.pz[i]) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation       Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0, size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical        break;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            exitCode = printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? blockPartition(static_cast<size_t>(numBodies), size, counts, displs);\n\n    Bodies bodies;\n    bodies.n = static_cast<size_t>(numBodies);\n    bodies.begin = static_cast<size_t>(displs[rank]);\n The inner\n// j loop is executed lane-wise for LANES different bodies i, so the compiler can\n// vectorize across i while every lane performs exactly the scalar sequence of\n// operations of the original implementation.\nconstexpr size_t LANES = 8;\n\n// Accumulates the force on LANES bodies (positions xi/yi/zi) from all n bodies.\n// The arithmetic is spelled out with explicit fma() calls to match the\n// fused-multiply-add pattern of the original (-O3 -march=native) scalar loop,\n// so the results are bitwise identical to the original program.\nstatic inline void forceKernel(const size_t n,\n                               const double* __restrict px,\n                               const double* __restrict py,\n                               const double* __restrict pz,\n                               const double* __restrict xi,\n                               const double* __restrict yi,\n                               const double* __restrict zi,\n                               double* __restrict Fx,\n                               double* __restrict Fy,\n                               double* __restrict Fz) {\n    for (size_t l = 0; l < LANES; ++l) {\n        Fx[l] = 0.0;\n        Fy[l] = 0.0;\n        Fz[l] = 0.0;\n    }\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const double xj = px[j], yj = py[j], zj = pz[j];\n        for (size_t l = 0; l < LANES; ++l) {\n            const double dx = xj - xi[l];\n            const double dy = yj - yi[l];\n            const double dz = zj - zi[l];\n            double distSqr = dy * dy;\n            distSqr = std::fma(dx, dx, distSqr);\n            distSqr = std::fma(dz, dz, distSqr);\n            distSqr += SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx[l] = std::fma(dx, invDist3, Fx[l]);\n            Fy[l] = std::fma(dy, invDist3, Fy[l]);\n            Fz[l] = std::fma(dz, invDist3, Fz[l]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes the force on every locally owned body from all n bodies and updates\n// the local velocities. Each lane runs over j in the original order, so the\n// floating-point accumulation order (and thus the result) is unchanged.\nvoid computeForces(Bodies& b) {\n    const size_t n = b.n;\n    const double* __restrict px = b.px.data();\n    const double* __restrict py = b.py.data();\n    const double* __restrict pz = b.pz.data();\n\n    alignas(64) double xi[LANES], yi[LANES], zi[LANES];\n    alignas(64) double Fx[LANES], Fy[LANES], Fz[LANES];\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < b.count; li += LANES) {\n        const size_t lanes = std::min(LANES, b.count - li);\n        for (size_t l = 0; l < LANES; ++l) {\n            // Pad the tail block with copies of its last valid body.\n            const size_t i = b.begin + li + std::min(l, lanes - 1);\n            xi[l] = px[i];\n            yi[l] = py[i];\n            zi[l] = pz[i];\n        }\n\n        forceKernel(n, px, py, pz, xi, yi, zi, Fx, Fy, Fz);\n\n        for (size_t l = 0; l < lanes; ++l) {\n            b.vx[li + l] += DT * Fx[l];\n            b.vy[li + l] += DT * Fy[l];\n            b.vz[li + l] += DT * Fz[l];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n'''\ns=s[:old_start]+new+s[old_end:]\ns=s.replace('#include <chrono>','#include <algorithm>\\n#include <chrono>')\nopen(p,'w').write(s)\nc='nbody/CMakeLists.txt'\nt=open(c).read()\nt=t.replace('''# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(nbody PRIVATE -O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra)''','''# Enable optimizations. r < size; ++r) {\n        const size_t c = base + (static_cast<size_t>(r) < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(off);\n        off += c;\n    }\n}\n\n// Generates exactly the same sequence as the original implementation: every\n// rank replays the generator, but only stores the data it needs (full positions,\n// local velocities).\n// (2.0 * r - 1.0 is written as an explicit fma to match the original build.)\nstatic inline double nextUniform(unsigned int& seed) {\n    return std::fma(2.0, rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX, -1.0);\n}\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(Bodies& b, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    const size_t end = b.begin + b.count;\n    for (size_t i = 0; Only `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt` were changed.\n\n**Parallelization design**\n\n- Each rank owns a contiguous block of bodies. Positions are replicated on all ranks in structure-of-arrays form, velocities are stored only for the local block.\n- Each step: compute forces for local bodies against all bodies, integrate local positions in place, then an in-place `MPI_Allgatherv` of positions. Velocities are gathered to rank 0 only at the end for the results output.\n- Initialization replays the same `rand_r` sequence on every rank, so the initial state is identical to the original.\n- Validation runs locally on each rank and is combined with an all-reduce. The final energy is computed in parallel with rows distributed cyclically and reduced to rank 0.\n- Only rank 0 prints. Timing is bracketed by barriers.\n\n**Bitwise reproducibility**\n\nThe original's `-O3 -march=native` build fuses specific multiply-adds into FMAs in the force loop, the position update, and the random init. The new kernel spells those out with explicit `std::fma` calls and the build uses `-ffp-contract=off`, so the output no longer depends on compiler heuristics. To still vectorize without changing accumulation order, the kernel processes 8 bodies i per inner iteration while each lane walks j in the original order. `-fno-math-errno` was added so `sqrt` vectorizes.\n\n**Verification** (hash, sum, min, max, and samples from `-r` diffed against the original binary)\n\n| Case | Result |\n|---|---|\n| n=4096, s=10, ranks 1/4/7/8/32 | identical |\n| n=1000 s=7 ranks 6, n=1001 s=5 ranks 1/7/13, n=13 s=3 ranks 5 | identical |\n| n=3 with 8 ranks, `-h`, bad option | behaves like the original |\n\nThe validation energy matches the original to the printed 6 decimals in the cases tested, but it is summed in a different order, so the last printed digit can differ for large n. That line is a diagnostic only.\n\n**Performance** (this 128-core EPYC node)\n\n| Config | Time |\n|---|---|\n| original, n=4096 s=10 | 1238 ms |\n| new, 1 rank | ~300 ms |\n| new, 32 ranks | 22 ms |\n| n=32768 s=5: 1 / 16 / 64 / 128 ranks | 10127 / 646 / 195 / 126 ms |\n\nBuild and run as before with `cmake` and `mpirun -np <P> ./nbody ...`.
